description:
Find the service manual for a car. Accepts how people describe it: brand, model name, year,
chassis code, engine or transmission code, e.g. "2004 Sentra 1.8", "B15", "QG18DE", "Mazda 3".
Returns manuals best match first, factory service manuals before owner's manuals; pass a
result's 'manual' to search / lookup_dtc / get_contents. A manual is one book: 'title', 'type'
(service, wiring, body, owners, features, parts, bulletins, accessory, brochure, article,
aftermarket; '' if
unknown), 'format' (pdf / html) and 'lang' say which; only English books are searchable. A year
folder's books share the folder: pass the folder ("Japan/Subaru/Forester/2008") as 'manual' to
search them all. A result with a 'file' is one book among
the loose files of a model folder: read it with read_pages(file, page) or
get_contents(manual, file); search and lookup_dtc on its 'manual' cover that whole folder.
A 17-character VIN or a Japanese frame number ("JZX100-0012345") is read as make, chassis code and
year; the results then say how under 'read_as'. An engine or transmission code finds the books that
print it, also written short or without hyphens ("k24" -> K24A3, "1jzgte" -> 1JZ-GTE); 'read_as' then
says what it is ("K24: Honda engine (K24A1, K24A3 ...)").
name: find_manuals
title: Find manuals
